capabilities: Schedule new, learning, review, and relearning cards with FSRS
Embed card fronts and backs from note headings or block IDs
Select review decks by tag with counts and nested-tag support
Validate and repair malformed card metadata and JSONL review history
Install a card-format skill for Codex and Claude Code
disambiguation: Not a search or retrieval tool; despite the name, its job is scheduling and reviewing flashcards.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it makes no network requests and requires no account or payment; detailed English and Japanese user guides live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition, and SRS tools that store state in external databases break the vault-as-plain-Markdown model.
